about: State unclaimed-property programs that send money or letters on their own (packages/domain/91-unclaimed.js; owner card M2-UNCLAIMED-01). A letter or email is called matching only when its sender's domain is the program's official domain on file; a mailed letter has no sender to check, so it is never called real: the person checks it on the official site they type in themselves. Facts come only from the owner's method cards (checked October 2026); add a state only from its official page. Re-check monthly; past fresh_days it is said to may have changed.

programs.name: Illinois Money Match
programs.stated: Illinois Money Match sends a letter naming the amount and source, then mails a check for simple single-owner cash claims, with no claim to file.
